description: Defines the ClientAddress entity class representing client address information within the Fineract portfolio module. The class is a JPA entity mapped to the m_client_address table, with fields for client, address, address type, and active status, along with related constructors and accessor methods.

classes.name: ClientAddress
classes.description: Entity class representing a client's address information, including associations to client, address, and address type, and a status flag indicating activeness.
